security_spec.violation_condition: OpenSBI writes to mvip (to inject virtual interrupts for VS-mode) before ensuring the corresponding mvien bits are set to 1, or writes mvip bits for interrupt numbers not in the MACHINE_VIRTUAL_INTERRUPTS WARL set. The spec gates mvip writability on mvien being both writable AND enabled: write to mvip.VSSIP returns 0 unless mvien.VSSIE==1. If OpenSBI sets mvip first then mvien, or sets mvip without checking mvien WARL constraints, the virtual interrupt injection is silently dropped.
security_spec.summary: mvip write silently dropped if mvien enable bit is not set first — virtual interrupt injection from M-mode OpenSBI to VS-mode guest requires mvien→mvip write ordering
